subject: SEARCH statement
notes: kb/Work/PB447.md LANDED — the one contradicted proposition is now delivered, so all four of GR9's normative propositions hold and the row closes. WHAT CHANGED: Format 2 no longer rides Format 1's scan. The emitter's single advance-then-test loop was split into TWO lowerings derived from the two rules that disagree — ControlFlowEmitter.EmitSerialScan (GR4, which forms the new index value and then judges it, so an unsuccessful serial search still ends at N+1, the state GR4 contemplates in as many words) and ControlFlowEmitter.EmitAllScan (GR9, which tests the bound BEFORE advancing, so the index moves only onto an occurrence that exists). The WHEN arms stay in ONE shared emission (EmitSearchWhens) because GR1/GR2 are ALL FORMATS rules, and the AT-END funnel stays shared for the same reason (GR1 b). BoundSearch.FromStart was renamed IsAll: the flag now selects a lowering rather than tweaking one. MEASURED, same probes as the defect record: gr9_nomatch_index over OCCURS 5 printed ATEND KX=06 / READ K(KX)=[0] / AFTER KX=06 before and prints ATEND KX=05 / READ K(KX)=[9] / AFTER KX=05 after — an in-range setting whose subscript reads a real element. The occurs-depending shape is the sharper case because storage and table differ: a 3-of-5 ODO table leaves JX=3 and J(JX)=5, not 4 and a phantom. The empty-table leg is unchanged (JX=1, NO-MATCH) and is now correct BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by accident — EmitAllScan makes no probe when no permissible setting exists. 'The initial setting of the search index is ignored' is now covered by a test and not only by a probe (SearchAll_IgnoresTheInitialSettingOfTheSearchIndex SETs KX to 5 past the only match at occurrence 1 and still finds it), closing the gap the previous record named in ec_range_search. THE FORMAT-1 COUNTERPART IS PINNED TOO, in the same class (Serial_Unsuccessful_LeavesTheIndexOnePastTheTable asserts 6 of 5), so the bound cannot later be swept onto the format GR4 licenses for it. Assertions on the unsuccessful Format-2 exit are RANGE assertions, never equality: GR9's own 'the final setting of the search index is undefined' (Annex A undefined item 51) forbids pinning WHICH in-range occurrence is left, while 'At no time is it set to a value that exceeds ... the last element of the table' is what is pinned. The failure branch was exercised: with the advance restored to its pre-fix order, 13 of the class's 37 cases go red across all four editions and all three table shapes (fixed, occurs-depending, OCCURS DYNAMIC); the empty-table case stays green, which is why a suite without the range assertions held this open. The implementor latitude is untouched and nothing is owed to docs/CONFORMANCE.md: GR9's 'A non serial type of search operation may take place ... in a manner specified by the implementor' still covers the ordered probe (Annex A implementor-defined item 170 says the internal procedure need not be documented), and only the range sentence — which is not latitude — was ever contradicted.
